name: Anchor-nav intro line
purpose: Introduces the sticky anchor tabs below it with a single centred prompt line.
description: A single centred 2rem/1.4 H2 (1.5rem at <=767), no paragraph or media. `variant` changes only placement: 'solutions' (/lms/solutions) renders a bare full-width H2 with 1rem top margin; 'features' (/lms/features) wraps it in padding-global > container-medium with 4rem top margin. Always rendered immediately before the sticky-tabs block.

heading.measuredLongestRealInstance: 5 words in the clone's own placeholder copy

constraints.maxPerPageDerivation: derived: the most times this (section, variant) occurs on any real template (templates/templates.json)

motion.reducedMotionNote: The schema REQUIRES this fallback on every generated node. Neither the original site nor the clone implements prefers-reduced-motion; this is a generation-time requirement, not a description of the source.

responsive.derivation: auto: breakpoint-prefixed classes on the cited line, paired with their unprefixed base

evidenceNotes: Both pages use the component default heading per variant. The section is a sibling of StickyTabs (not inside it), so no structural mustImmediatelyFollow is declared; on both pages it directly precedes product.sticky-tabs.

compatibility.note: Derived from every real node sequence in templates/templates.json (incl. per-route sequences).
